title: Improper check for unusual or exceptional conditions in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization - Secure Nested Paging…
description: CVE-2026-40670 is a vulnerability in AMD Secure Encrypted Virtualization - Secure Nested Paging (SEV-SNP) caused by improper checks for unusual or exceptional conditions. This flaw could allow a privileged attacker to overlap MMIO regions with DRAM regions, potentially leading to loss of integrity within the system.
